questions.text: What should you do if an item is not on your shopping list?
options: Put it in the cart anyway
Leave it and stick to the list
Ask a friend to buy it
Buy it if it looks fun
questions.explanation: If it's not on the list, it's a want, so we stick to our plan and don't add it.

questions.text: Bright candy bars by the checkout are on the shopping list.
questions.explanation: The candy bars are not on the list; they are sneaky tricks to make us want extra things.
